Library.title: Spiritual Library
Library.subtitle: Discover and read timeless sacred texts, scriptures, and hymns. Choose a book below to start reading.

gita.title: Srimad Bhagavad Gita
gita.description: The divine wisdom of Lord Krishna, guiding humanity through the battlefield of life with profound spiritual philosophy.

hanuman-chalisa.title: Hanuman Chalisa
hanuman-chalisa.description: A Hindu devotional hymn addressed to Lord Hanuman, composed by Tulsidas, invoking courage, devotion, and divine protection.

durga-saptashati.title: Durga Saptashati (Devi Mahatmyam)
durga-saptashati.description: A profound Hindu philosophical text describing the victory of Goddess Durga over the demon Mahishasura, symbolizing the triumph of good over evil.

vishnu-sahasranama.title: Vishnu Sahasranama
vishnu-sahasranama.description: A sacred stotra containing a thousand names of Lord Vishnu, found in the Mahabharata, chanted for spiritual purification and inner peace.

satyanarayan-panchali.title: Sri Sri Satyanarayaner Panchali
satyanarayan-panchali.description: The sacred Bengali verses recounting the divine narrative and rituals of Lord Satyanarayan, traditionally read during household Pujas.

lokkhi-brotokotha.title: Maa Lokkhi Brotokotha
lokkhi-brotokotha.description: The sacred Bengali verses and stories of Goddess Lakshmi, recited every Thursday in Bengali households for wealth and prosperity.

purohit-darpan.title: Purohit Darpan
purohit-darpan.description: The ultimate Bengali reference manual for Hindu priests (Purohits) detailing the meticulous rules, mantras, and procedures for conducting various Pujas and Sanskaras.

bishuddha-nityakarma-paddhati.title: Bishuddha Nityakarma Paddhati
bishuddha-nityakarma-paddhati.description: A comprehensive Bengali guide outlining the daily religious duties, rituals, and prayers essential for maintaining a disciplined spiritual life.

ramayana.title: Valmiki Ramayana
ramayana.description: The epic narrative of Lord Rama, illustrating the ideals of dharma, devotion, and righteousness as chronicled by Sage Valmiki.

sri-isopanisad.title: Sri Isopanisad
sri-isopanisad.description: One of the principal Upanishads conveying the essence of Vedic knowledge, teaching that everything in the universe belongs to the Supreme Lord.
